title: SignalX Zero component recipe (RecipeInput)
description: The argument to @sigx/zero-kit's defineRecipe(), as plain JSON data: per-part styles for one component, resolved against that component's anatomy in the zero manifest. An AI (or any tool) can emit this JSON, wrap it in defineRecipe(...) and run `zero-kit validate` — this schema catches structural mistakes; whether a part, state or var(--…) reference actually exists is the validator's job, because it depends on the anatomy and the token declaration.

component.description: The component scope this recipe styles (e.g. "tabs") — must match an anatomy scope in the zero manifest.

tokens.description: Component-level tokens declared on the carrier part (root, else the first part), overridable per theme via ThemeInput.components.

variants.description: axis → value → part → styles. The contract axes (color, size, variant) have named props; any other kebab-case axis is reachable through zero's `axes` prop. Axis names and values are written into [data-<axis>="<value>"] selectors, hence the kebab-case grammar on both.

compoundVariants.description: Styles applied when several axis values hold at once.

match.description: axis → value; every pair must match for the styles to apply.

defaultVariants.description: axis → value applied when the axis attribute is absent (CSS-only defaults, compiled to :not([data-<axis>]) selectors).

keyframes.description: name → raw keyframes body ("from { … } to { … }"), emitted as @keyframes <name> after the recipe's layer block.

css.description: Raw CSS appended verbatim at the end of this component's @layer zero.recipes block — the escape hatch for anything the typed surface can't express.

skipStates.description: part → declared states/flags intentionally left unstyled; silences the validator's coverage warning for them.

kebabToken.description: A kebab-case identifier that may start with a digit — the grammar for anything written into a [data-…] selector (scopes, parts, axes, axis values).

cssProps.description: CSS declarations: property → value. Property names may be camelCase (kebab-cased at compile time) or custom properties (--x, kept verbatim); numbers are emitted as-is, so use them only for unitless values.

partStyles.description: Styles for one part. `at` maps a condition — a declared breakpoint name, a built-in (reduced-motion, hover-none, prefers-dark, forced-colors, starting-style) or a raw "@…" prelude — to this same shape, recursively; nesting composes the at-rules.

states.description: state/flag/interaction name → declarations. Names resolve through the anatomy: machine states → [data-state="…"], flags → [data-…], interactions → real pseudo-classes. An empty object marks a state as deliberately covered without emitting CSS.

selectors.description: Nested selectors; `&` is the part selector (a key without `&` is treated as a descendant).

partsRecord.description: part name → styles. Part names must exist in the component's anatomy — the compiler and validator both fail on an unknown part.
